title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional backoff to prevent thrashing
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: This hotfix addresses a production incident where the SLO enforcer's regional backoff logic could enter a thrashing loop during cross-region failover. Symptom: short exponential backoff + simultaneous region switches caused repeated load-shedding spikes and SLO violations. Root cause: backoff hysteresis was computed per-region without quorum checks and lacked jitter and max-cap scaling for clustered failover events. This change: 1) introduce a per-failure-window quorum check so transient single-node signals don't trigger global backoff, 2) bound exponential backoff with a configurable max_backoff and add randomized jitter to avoid synchronized retries, 3) move critical path calculation off the hot path and add a lightweight cache to avoid lock contention, 4) add e2e regression test that replays the incident trace, and 5) ship behind a feature flag (slo_enforcer_regional_backoff_v2) for staged rollout. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced failure in perf-canary simulation harness - [x] Unit tests for backoff math and quorum logic - [x] Integration test for regional failover scenario - [x] Manual canary in us-west-2 for 30m - [x] Rollout plan attached in PR comments - [x] Cherrypick to release/2026-02 branch included in separate commit Notes: This is intentionally conservative logic; we prioritize avoiding over-shedding over immediate failover. Configuration defaults are tuned to previous incident telemetry (see linked Linear items).

incident_reference: Investigation: Incident 2026-02-10 - regional failover caused SLO enforcer thrashing
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional backoff to prevent failover thrashing. Adds quorum checks, bounded exponential backoff, jitter, and feature flag for staged rollout.
notes_for_ops: Deploy uses feature flag slo_enforcer_regional_backoff_v2=false by default. Enable in one region, monitor slo_enforcer.over_shedding_rate and request_latency P95 for 1h before enabling globally. Config knobs: max_backoff (default 60s), base_backoff (default 1s), jitter_pct (default 0.2).
